name: zubra-example-standup-worker
description: The standup board on a Cloudflare Worker, with no server of its own: @zubra/sync in a Durable Object (SyncObject, its log in the object's SQLite), a form that posts to a 'use server' function (@zubra/actions/edge), pages from @zubra/server/edge. Its tests run it in workerd with two browsers.
